name: Artemis Esports
shortDescription: An iRacing endurance, GT and NASCAR oval team.
heroLead: An iRacing endurance, GT and NASCAR oval team. We run the long races, the short tracks, and we bring the car home.
mission: Artemis builds in silence, improves with intention, and competes with precision. We put people first, chase real progress, and let our results speak louder than the noise.
focus: Endurance and GT racing on iRacing

pillars.title: Work over words
pillars.detail: An entry is announced when the car is on the grid, not when somebody has the idea.

pillars.title: Progress over pride
pillars.line: Improvement is the standard, not the reward.
pillars.detail: A clean sixth that fixed last week's mistake is worth more here than a lucky podium.

pillars.title: Precision over flash
pillars.detail: Stint plan, fuel number and pit window are agreed before the green flag, not argued over during it.

pillars.title: Culture over clout
pillars.line: Built for our people, not the noise.
pillars.detail: The roster stays small so everyone gets seat time. Nobody is signed to sit out a season.

join.lead: We take drivers who show up prepared and stay calm in traffic. Pace matters. So does the hour before the race.

steps.title: Open a ticket
steps.line: Join the Discord and open a driver application in #recruitment.

steps.title: Share your numbers
steps.line: Your iRacing name, iRating, safety rating and the classes you run.

steps.title: Get in a car
steps.line: Run a practice session with the crew. Most drivers are placed within two weeks.
